```yaml
name: Rule Type Param Changes Comment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-group-rename:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for old group references
        id: check-references
        run: |
          # Define the old and new group names
          OLD_GROUP="kibana/cloud-security-posture"
          NEW_GROUP="kibana/contextual-security"
          
          # Search for references in specific high-priority files/folders
          # We look in .github, CODEOWNERS, and root config files
          FILES_TO_CHECK=(
            ".github/CODEOWNERS"
            ".github/workflows/*.yml"
            ".github/workflows/*.yaml"
            ".github/actions/**/*.yml"
            ".github/actions/**/*.yaml"
            "CODEOWNERS"
          )
          
          FOUND_REFS=()
          
          for pattern in "${FILES_TO_CHECK[@]}"; do
            # Use find to get actual files matching the glob
            while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
              if grep -q "$OLD_GROUP" "$file"; then
                FOUND_REFS+=("$file")
              fi
            done < <(find . -path "$pattern" -type f -print0 2>/dev/null || true)
          done
          
          if [ ${#FOUND_REFS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            # Create a list of files for the comment
            REF_LIST=""
            for file in "${FOUND_REFS[@]}"; do
              REF_LIST+="\n- \`${file}\`"
            done
            echo "ref_list=$REF_LIST" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "found=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post comment if old references found
        if: steps.check-references.outputs.found == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const refList = `${{ steps.check-references.outputs.ref_list }}`;
            const message = `## ⚠️ Old Group Reference Detected

            We have renamed the GitHub group from \`kibana/cloud-security-posture\` to \`kibana/contextual-security\`.
            
            The following files in this PR still contain references to the old group name:
            
            ${refList}
            
            Please update these references to use the new group name \`kibana/contextual-security\`.
            
            > Note: Textual mentions in comments/docs are not urgent but can be updated in a follow-up.`;

            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: message
            });
```
